items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: We didn't have but one or two good drummers around, Ron Wallings. I mean, real drummers.

ctx.x: Yeah, oh, yeah, this is all nice to have this down on there. Just received the coat. Yeah, he can sure write some crazy letters.

You know, we're going to get back to some... We had some very... We didn't have but one or two good drummers around, Ron Wallings. I mean, real drummers. The drummers that could fit with any kind of band. And they was from some of the French boys, like Cantrell.
